exercises.prompt: Identify the grammatical role and case of الرِّسَالَةُ in كُتِبَتِ الرِّسَالَةُ.
exercises.explanation: In a passive clause (كُتِبَتْ), the direct object is promoted to nāʾib al-fāʿil and takes the nominative case.

feedback.rule: Passive verbs take a nominative nāʾib al-fāʿil instead of an active fāʿil.

exercises.prompt: Select the passive past tense of فَتَحَ ('it was opened').
exercises.explanation: Form I past passive follows the vowel melody فُعِلَ (u–i–a): فُتِحَ.
